trap-nonspeakable.notes: THREE RECOMPUTED FLAGS for the report. (1) THE NUMBER IS WRONG: m(4_1) = Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2 = 2.02988321/hbar_q^2 evaluates to 206.7683 at the proton pin, 206.768283 at the muon pin and 206.768283 at the old muon value - and 207.7155 at the erroneous 1.1097. The block prints 207.1, which corresponds to q = 1.1098808, a FOURTH value matching no documented pin. Against CODATA m_mu/m_e = 206.7682830 the printed 207.1 is a 0.160 pct miss where the formula itself achieves 2.1e-5 pct, so 'This matches the muon-to-electron mass ratio' understates the agreement by four orders of magnitude while printing a number that is simply not the formula's value. (2) NOTATION: the trefoil is written tau(2,3), but tau is reserved for the fibre functor (AGENTS.md section 7) and every other block in this chapter writes T_{m,p}. (3) SCOPE: prop:topological-mass-formula states the mass formula only for a HYPERBOLIC knot; this block applies it to the trefoil, which its own first line calls non-hyperbolic, via an unstated substitution Vol -> Li_2(q^-2). For the record that substitution gives Li_2(q_0^-2)/hbar_q^2 = 111.90, so the block's two examples stand in ratio 1.85, not m_mu/m_e. And 4_1 is the HIGGS in tbl:topological-field-ansatz-table-data, which this block's own first line repeats before reading its value as the muon ratio.
